module ImpracticalTransport
{
    imports { Base }

    /* Held two-handed. Icon and texture are generated by tools/blender/pogo_stick.py. */
    item PogoStick
    {
        DisplayName = Pogo Stick,
        ItemType = base:weapon,
        Weight = 2.5,
        Icon = PogoStick,
        WeaponSprite = PogoStick_3d,
        WorldStaticModel = PogoStick_3d,
        TwoHandWeapon = TRUE,
        RequiresEquippedBothHands = TRUE,
        MaxRange = 0.5,
        MinDamage = 0.1,
        MaxDamage = 0.2,
        Tags = ImpracticalTransport;
    }

    /* A child's tricycle under a grown rider. Held two-handed; model, texture and icon come from tools/blender/tricycle.py. */
    item Tricycle
    {
        DisplayName = Tricycle,
        ItemType = base:weapon,
        Weight = 6.0,
        Icon = Tricycle,
        WeaponSprite = Tricycle_3d,
        WorldStaticModel = Tricycle_3d,
        TwoHandWeapon = TRUE,
        RequiresEquippedBothHands = TRUE,
        MaxRange = 0.5,
        MinDamage = 0.1,
        MaxDamage = 0.2,
        Tags = ImpracticalTransport;
    }

    /* A unicycle: balance is the whole job. Held two-handed; model, texture and icon come from tools/blender/unicycle.py. */
    item Unicycle
    {
        DisplayName = Unicycle,
        ItemType = base:weapon,
        Weight = 5.0,
        Icon = Unicycle,
        WeaponSprite = Unicycle_3d,
        WorldStaticModel = Unicycle_3d,
        TwoHandWeapon = TRUE,
        RequiresEquippedBothHands = TRUE,
        MaxRange = 0.5,
        MinDamage = 0.1,
        MaxDamage = 0.2,
        Tags = ImpracticalTransport;
    }

    /* Roller skates: a worn shoe item (experiment, first step: no model of their own yet). The Lua sees them in the shoes slot and puts the rider in the skating state. */
    item RollerSkates
    {
        DisplayCategory = Clothing,
        ItemType = base:clothing,
        Icon = Shoes,
        BodyLocation = base:shoes,
        ClothingItem = RollerSkates,
        BloodLocation = Shoes,
        Weight = 1.5,
        Tags = ImpracticalTransport;
    }
}
